title: Mission
description: A declared north-star outcome with success criteria, constraints, and budget. Survives compactions and sessions; drives /mission, /dev-loop, /continue behavior.

id.description: URL-safe slug. Must be unique per workspace.

overall_goal_condition.description: Single measurable + transcript-observable statement that, when true, means the entire mission is complete. This is the /goal argument when the mission is dispatched to Claude Code or Codex. Must contain: (a) one measurable end state, (b) a stated check, (c) constraints that matter. Minimum 50 characters to prevent vague entries. Example: 'All 11 PRDs in Phase 1 of the auth-rebuild mission ship to main with 8 pipeline gates green; no gap-analysis rounds find new issues.' Anti-examples: 'we are done' (not measurable), 'tests pass' (not specific), 'good vibes' (not anything).

workspace.description: SigmaHQ workspace path under ~/.commandboard/workspaces/. Use 'missions/' category for cross-project missions.

parent_id.description: ID of parent mission if this is a sub-mission. null for top-level.

children.description: IDs of sub-missions. Forms a DAG with parent_id.

status.description: Lifecycle state. 'runnable' = ready to become active but not currently the leaf; used by stack resolver to find the next sibling after a child completes.

deadline.description: Soft deadline for mission completion. Triggers halt_on.deadline_passed when reached.

budget.description: Resource caps. Exceeding any triggers halt_on.budget_exceeded.

do_not_touch.description: Projects/paths this mission must never modify.

last_result.description: Tri-state. 'unknown' when source file missing, command errors, or URL unreachable — never silently treated as 'fail'.

last_evidence.description: Observed value/output at last_check time. Snapshot for ledger replay.

latched_pass.description: Once true, remains true until mission is explicitly re-opened. Prevents oscillation if a source file disappears post-completion.

latched_at.description: Timestamp when latched_pass flipped to true.

machine_checks.description: Runnable predicates. Halt oracle counts these as deterministic PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN evidence. Completion is latched (latched_pass=true) — once a check passes it stays passed even if the source goes missing.

prompt.description: Question to put to the user or LLM evaluator.

soft_criteria.description: LLM-assessed criteria. Must include human sign-off for completion.

halt_on.description: Conditions that end the mission loop. 'all_checks_pass' requires machine_checks true AND every soft_criteria.last_answer == 'yes'.

keywords.description: Exa search terms. Scored for relevance before ledger entry.

relevance_threshold.description: 0.0-1.0. Findings below this relevance are discarded.

ledger_path.description: Path relative to the mission directory for the append-only OODA log.

workspace_links.description: Additional workspace paths this mission touches (for reconciliation scans).
